report_title: FloodLens AI — Flood-Depth Modelling Input Readiness Assessment
study_area: Sapta Koshi Basin — Barahachhetra / Chatara, Sunsari District, Nepal Terai

inputs.relevance_to_depth_modelling: Primary meteorological forcing for surface runoff volume and flash inundation accumulation.
inputs.source_and_format: Open-Meteo ERA5 hourly reanalysis CSV + synthetic Koshi rainfall time-series.
inputs.spatial_coverage_and_resolution: ~25 km grid cell for ERA5 (Point proxy at Lat 26.87°N, Lon 87.16°E).
inputs.missing_data_and_quality_issues: ERA5 25 km grid averages smooth out intense localized mountain cloudbursts; in-situ DHM AWS automatic rain gauges are unavailable via automated REST API.
inputs.suitability_for_current_prototype: SUITABLE for area-level runoff proxy and multi-horizon risk scoring; INSUFFICIENT for street-scale hydrodynamic water depth.
inputs.additional_data_needed_for_operational_u: Automated API telemetry from high-altitude DHM mountain rain gauges (Chatara 1204, Dharan 1206) and calibrated radar rainfall (GPM IMERG 10 km / dual-pol Doppler).

inputs.relevance_to_depth_modelling: Foundational geometric boundary for hydraulic head, gravity drainage routing, and stage-to-inundation mapping.
inputs.source_and_format: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 / SRTM 30m raster (GeoTIFF, referenced in GIS specifications).
inputs.spatial_coverage_and_resolution: 30-meter horizontal resolution; global coverage spanning Koshi basin.
inputs.physical_units: Meters above sea level (WGS84 ellipsoidal / EGM2008 geoid).
inputs.missing_data_and_quality_issues: 30m resolution is far too coarse to resolve urban roadside culverts, drainage ditches, road embankments, and channel levee crests in the flat Terai plain (vertical RMSE ~1.5m, often exceeding flood depth).
inputs.suitability_for_current_prototype: SUITABLE for macroscopic basin slope and coarse terrain visualization; INSUFFICIENT for sub-meter floodwater depth estimation.
inputs.additional_data_needed_for_operational_u: High-resolution airborne LiDAR or drone photogrammetry DEM (1-meter resolution, vertical accuracy <= 0.15 m) for settlement floodplains.

inputs.input_name: Terrain Slope and Low-Lying Topographic Depressions
inputs.relevance_to_depth_modelling: Determines flow velocity, ponding potential, and water surface gradient along drainage paths.
inputs.source_and_format: Derivable from 30m DEM via spatial gradient and Topographic Wetness Index (TWI) algorithms.
inputs.spatial_coverage_and_resolution: 30-meter resolution across Barahachhetra / Chatara study area.
inputs.physical_units: Degrees slope (0°–90°) or percentage gradient; TWI unitless index.
inputs.missing_data_and_quality_issues: Flat alluvial Terai plain features gradients < 0.1%, causing flow direction algorithms (D8, D-infinity) to fail without artificial stream burning.
inputs.suitability_for_current_prototype: SUITABLE for relative hazard indexing; INSUFFICIENT for hydrodynamic ponding depth calculation.
inputs.additional_data_needed_for_operational_u: Hydro-conditioned DEM with culvert and bridge enforcement (stream burning) to avoid false damming artifacts.

inputs.input_name: Drainage Network Density, Channel Capacity, and Blockages
inputs.relevance_to_depth_modelling: Directly governs whether surface runoff drains safely or ponds into streets and agricultural parcels.
inputs.source_and_format: None available in repository or public Nepal municipal repositories.
inputs.spatial_coverage_and_resolution: Unmapped for Barahachhetra Ward 2 rural drainage networks.
inputs.temporal_coverage_and_frequency: No real-time sensor feeds or maintenance logs.
inputs.physical_units: m3/s drainage discharge capacity; percentage trash-rack blockage.
inputs.missing_data_and_quality_issues: Complete data void: no culvert dimensions, no invert elevations, no debris accumulation records.
inputs.suitability_for_current_prototype: UNAVAILABLE. Prototype cannot model localized drainage surcharge.
inputs.additional_data_needed_for_operational_u: Municipal stormwater GIS asset inventory (culvert dimensions, outfall locations, invert levels) and community-reported blockage telemetry.

inputs.input_name: River Channel Bathymetry and Continuous Water-Level Records
inputs.relevance_to_depth_modelling: Essential for hydraulic backwater curves, bankfull discharge calculation, and overbank inundation depth.
inputs.source_and_format: DHM Chatara Station 695 benchmark thresholds (Warning: 6.0m, Danger: 7.0m); GloFAS reanalysis discharge proxy.
inputs.spatial_coverage_and_resolution: Single point station (Lat 26.87°N, Lon 87.16°E); no cross-sectional bathymetry surveys.
inputs.temporal_coverage_and_frequency: Hourly benchmark specifications documented; live automated DHM API offline.
inputs.missing_data_and_quality_issues: River cross-section geometry (channel bottom topography below water surface) is completely absent. Without channel bathymetry, river water level cannot be translated into floodplain inundation depth.
inputs.suitability_for_current_prototype: SUITABLE for threshold-based upstream hazard warning; INSUFFICIENT for continuous water depth simulation.
inputs.additional_data_needed_for_operational_u: Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler (ADCP) cross-sectional bathymetry surveys for Sapta Koshi reach from Chatara to Koshi Barrage, plus restored DHM telemetry.

inputs.input_name: Historical Flood Extent Polygons and Ground-Truth Depth Observations
inputs.relevance_to_depth_modelling: Critical for model calibration, loss function formulation, and empirical depth validation.
inputs.source_and_format: Sentinel-2 optical NDWI/MNDWI flood extent polygons (Member 2 GIS pipeline).
inputs.spatial_coverage_and_resolution: 10-meter optical pixels across Sapta Koshi floodplain.
inputs.temporal_coverage_and_frequency: Discrete satellite overpasses (5-day revisit for Sentinel-2, often cloud-obscured during monsoon).
inputs.physical_units: Binary water presence (0/1); area in km2; NO DEPTH MEASUREMENTS.
inputs.missing_data_and_quality_issues: CRITICAL GAP: Satellite optical and radar sensors detect surface water presence/extent, NOT water depth. High-water marks (HWM), peg readings, or field-surveyed flood depths are absent.
inputs.suitability_for_current_prototype: Extent is SUITABLE for 2D spatial validation; Depth is MISSING and CANNOT BE VALIDATED against real observations.
inputs.additional_data_needed_for_operational_u: Post-flood field survey depth measurements, citizen water-level geotags, or calibrated ultrasonic river staff gauges.

inputs.input_name: Soil Infiltration, Land Cover, and Surface Roughness (Manning's n)
inputs.relevance_to_depth_modelling: Determines runoff infiltration loss (SCS Curve Number) and hydraulic flow friction resistance.
inputs.source_and_format: Global FAO Harmonized World Soil Database (HWSD) & ESA WorldCover 10m land cover.
inputs.spatial_coverage_and_resolution: 10m land cover; 1 km soil hydrologic group.
inputs.physical_units: Hydrologic Soil Group (A/B/C/D); Manning's n roughness coefficient (0.025–0.150).
inputs.missing_data_and_quality_issues: Uncalibrated infiltration rates can create +/- 40% errors in overland runoff volume in tropical monsoon soils.
inputs.suitability_for_current_prototype: SUITABLE for relative runoff retention indexing; requires hydraulic calibration.
inputs.additional_data_needed_for_operational_u: In-situ double-ring infiltrometer soil tests in Sunsari farming zones.

inputs.input_name: Simulated or Deployed IoT Water-Level Sensor Feeds
inputs.relevance_to_depth_modelling: Provides dense real-time ground truth for boundary assimilation and automated depth calibration.
inputs.missing_data_and_quality_issues: Sensor hardware network is not yet deployed.
inputs.suitability_for_current_prototype: MISSING. Do not invent simulated sensor readings without explicit demo fixtures.
inputs.additional_data_needed_for_operational_u: Deployment of solar-powered LoRaWAN ultrasonic or radar distance sensors on Chatara bridge and Barahachhetra drainage culverts.

recommended_modelling_approach.recommended_approach: Height Above Nearest Drainage (HAND) + Stage-Discharge Rating Curve (Empirical)
recommended_modelling_approach.rationale: Because cross-sectional channel bathymetry, street drainage capacity, and ground-truth depth observations are completely absent, numerical 2D hydrodynamic simulation (e.g. full shallow-water equations in HEC-RAS 2D) or ML depth regression would suffer from severe unconstrained equifinality. The HAND method provides a robust, physically grounded topographic relative head model once DHM stage is integrated, avoiding the fabrication of unverified sub-meter water depths.
recommended_modelling_approach.prototype_recommendation: Retain discrete 4-tier risk classification (+1h, +3h, +6h) for the operational baseline. Document depth estimation as an experimental research track (P2/P3) until channel bathymetry is surveyed.

unsupported_modelling_approaches.approach: Direct Machine Learning Regression of Flood Depth (meters)
unsupported_modelling_approaches.why_unsupported: Zero ground-truth water depth training labels exist in the historical record. Training an ML regressor on synthetic or uncalibrated depth labels would violate core engineering safety rules and produce misleading depth predictions for disaster response.

unsupported_modelling_approaches.approach: Fully Dynamic 2D Hydrodynamic Modeling (e.g. shallow-water equations)
unsupported_modelling_approaches.why_unsupported: Requires cross-sectional river bathymetry, 1-meter LiDAR topography, and culvert geometry. Applying 30m DEM directly results in vertical errors (1.5 m) exceeding typical flood depths, creating massive numerical instabilities and false damming.

next_steps_action_plan: 1. Maintain clear separation between categorical flood risk (low/moderate/high/critical) and floodwater depth.
2. Coordinate with Nepal DHM / Department of Water Resources & Irrigation (DWRI) to obtain Sapta Koshi Chatara ADCP river cross-section bathymetry.
3. Ingest high-resolution Copernicus DEM or national LiDAR tiles for Barahachhetra Ward 2 when released.
4. Prototype a HAND (Height Above Nearest Drainage) terrain layer using the DEM as a relative flood hazard index.
5. Deploy low-cost ultrasonic IoT staff gauges on critical bridges to establish true depth calibration points.
